name: Hitani Mario
source:
"Fu... it seems that my turn has come" 

 From Arashino School, he's a cool snob who doesn't listen to a word others say. It seems he's searching for the one who killed his lover, but... 

 Battle quote - "Fu... have a listen. To my melody of revenge!"
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
